My first transformation projects.

Before I coached anyone else, I started with my own family. Rutuja and Tejas taught me the one thing no course can: there is no single transformation that fits everybody. Different people, different starting points, different journeys.

Rutuja

Fat loss & recomposition

She did not need a harder diet, she needed one she could actually live with. We fixed portions, protein and consistency around a routine that was not going to change for anybody — and this time the result stayed.

Her journey is the reason I stopped believing in one plan for everyone.

He is proof that the slow version is the one that lasts.

Meet your coach

Three chapters of my life.

Eight years ago I started with a body that looked nothing like the one I wanted. I trained naturally, studied nutrition, got plenty of it wrong, and slowly built a system that survives a normal week. I have been the skinny one, the fit one, and the one who had to rebuild himself from scratch. Whatever chapter you are in right now, you do not have to stay there.

My transformation

Swipe

›
Chapter I · The beginning

Skinny — Fit

I started with a body that looked nothing like the one I wanted. There was no shortcut, only years of training, learning and patience. This chapter taught me how to build muscle and trust the process.

›
Chapter II · The setback

Fit — Fat

Then life happened. During lockdown my routine changed, my food changed, and I gained far more weight than I wanted. The physique went, and so did the confidence. This chapter taught me that progress is not linear.

›
Chapter III · The comeback

Fat — Fit

I decided to start again and rebuilt my training, nutrition and lifestyle from scratch. Transformation is not about never falling off track. It is about knowing how to find your way back.

That is the whole road. If you want the short version of it, the plans are above.

My promise

Read this as a contract.

I won’t promise you overnight results.

I promise you something more valuable — a coach who genuinely cares about your progress.

I will give you a plan built around your body, your lifestyle and your goals, not a template made for everyone.

I’ll be honest with you, challenge you when you need it, support you when things get difficult, and help you understand the why behind what we do.

But I don’t want to transform just your physique.

I want to help you transform your life 360°.

Your body. Your skin. Your hair health. Your fitness. Your daily habits. Your sleep. Your discipline. Your confidence. And, where relevant, your study and exam preparation.

Because looking better is only one part of becoming better.

Your results will always depend on your consistency and commitment. But if you’re willing to show up, I’ll be there to guide you through every step of the journey.

My goal isn’t just to help you transform your body. It’s to help you build a version of yourself you never want to lose.

And when you look back after this journey, I want you to realise: you didn’t just change your physique. You changed your life.

Before you pay.

What is the difference between VIP and a standard package?
Standard gives you a fully personal training and diet plan with weekly progress tracking. VIP puts me inside your whole life for three months — recomposition, skin, sleep, recovery, cardio, supplements, study planning and direct mentorship on my own WhatsApp. Only five VIP slots open each month, because that is as many as I can give real attention to.
I have never trained before. Is this too advanced?
No. Most people who join have never followed a structured plan. Every exercise comes with a video and a written cue, and week one is deliberately easy so that week eight is possible.
Do I need a gym membership?
No. Tell me what you have — a full gym, a pair of dumbbells or nothing at all — and the plan is written for that. If you upgrade mid-plan, I rewrite it.
Will I have to give up roti and rice?
No. Your diet is built around your own preferences, veg, non-veg or eggs only, using budget-friendly food and simple recipes. Indian food is not the problem. Unmeasured portions and unplanned days are.
How soon do I get my plan?
I connect with you personally first to understand your goals and situation. Allow five to seven days after that for your assessment and programme to be designed properly. Nothing is pulled off a shelf.
I have thyroid, PCOS or another condition. Can you still help?
I can guide weight management, training and lifestyle habits around conditions like diabetes, thyroid, blood pressure and PCOS/PCOD. Your medical treatment stays with your doctor — I work alongside it, never instead of it.

They were my personal projects.

Now you will be my next one. Five VIP slots open each month, and they are given to people who are ready to do the work.
